text:
Maya: Heads up: unofficial event idea  Model Olympics. tiny contests, zero infra changes, all snacks. Who's in? :trophy:
Jorge: in if there's a 'fastest prompt' relay. We can time how fast a model answers a simple query. :stopwatch:
Leah: I'll bring a 'persona cosplay' round. dress your prompt as if the model were an intern, a pirate, or a barista. :pirate_flag: :coffee:
Tom: can we have a 'no hallucination' medal? maybe judge answers on factualness and creativity separately. :medal_sports:
Maya: event rules draft (very casual): 1) 3 rounds (speed, persona, accuracy). 2) teams of 2. 3) winner gets first pick of the snack box. :confetti_ball:
Jorge: team names: "Quantized Quokkas" vs "Cache Cowboys" :laughing:
Leah: sample persona prompt I'll use: ```You are "Penny", a cheerful office barista who refuses to make up facts and always asks for clarification. Keep replies under 30 words.```
Tom: love a short system prompt. my persona: "Grumpy Legacy Sysadmin" who only speaks in haiku about downtime. :see_no_evil:
Maya: small logistics: date? Friday lunchtime or post-standup Weds? vote with emoji. :ballot_box:
Jorge: Friday lunchtime +1 (emoji reaction: :+1:)
Leah: Weds post-standup +1 (emoji reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Tom: leaning Friday so folks can bring snacks. also propose a 'team mascot' micro-contest (5 sec to draw a mascot). :pencil2:
Maya: SnackBot: can we reserve the big table Friday 12:30-1:30? :robot_face:
SnackBot: Reservation confirmed for "Model Olympics" — Table C, 12:30-13:30. Please dispose of crumbs responsibly. (automated)
Jorge: okay last thing: judge panel = volunteers? Leah, Tom, Maya, Jorge happy to co-judge. any objections?
Leah: fine by me. I'll prepare a 1-slide score rubric: speed / persona / accuracy. simple numbers.
Tom: I'll bring the timer and a tiny bell for dramatic effect.
Maya: perfect. I'll make a tiny sign: "Model Olympics: prompts not included" :joy: see you Friday, bring weird prompts and your appetite.
